title: Add per-item camera attachment with inline capture

requirements.text: Add a small attach image button next to each of the 7 checklist items (Drive thru window, Back door, Front door, Upstairs door, Cash collected, OnlineHM App closed, Staff toilet)

quotes: each checklist should have a small attach image button

acceptanceCriteria: Each checklist item displays a small attach image button
Button is positioned next to the checkbox and label
Button follows neumorphic design system
Button is touch-friendly with minimum 44px tap target

requirements.text: When user clicks the attach image button, display an inline camera interface within the screen (not as a popup or modal) that allows photo capture

quotes: by clicking on it a small camera window in screen will appear not popup

acceptanceCriteria: Camera interface appears inline within the main screen flow
Camera is not displayed in a popup, modal, or separate window
Camera preview is visible and functional
User can capture photo directly from this inline view

requirements.text: Allow users to associate the captured photo with the specific checklist item that triggered the camera

quotes: user can take photo and select the checklist

acceptanceCriteria: Photo is linked to the correct checklist item
Visual indication shows which item has an attached photo
User can see thumbnail or confirmation of attached photo per item

requirements.text: Update the backend submission logic to accept multiple photos, one per checklist item, instead of a single photo for the entire form
acceptanceCriteria: Backend accepts array of photos with corresponding checklist item identifiers
Each photo is stored with its associated checklist item
Submission maintains store name, item statuses, and timestamp as before

requirements.text: Update the PDF generation to include all captured photos, showing each photo next to its corresponding checklist item
acceptanceCriteria: PDF displays each checklist item with its associated photo
Photos are properly formatted and sized within the PDF
PDF maintains store name, item statuses, and timestamp

requirements.text: Update form reset functionality to clear all per-item photos when the form is reset after submission
acceptanceCriteria: All captured photos are removed on form reset
All attach image buttons return to initial state
Camera interface is closed if open

constraints: Camera interface must be inline within the main screen, not a popup or modal
Maintain existing neumorphic design system throughout new components
Keep existing 7 predefined checklist items unchanged
nonGoals: Editing or removing individual photos after capture
